b1plus-lazim.title: Must/Should: Lazim
b1plus-lazim.explanation: لازم (laazim, "must/should/have to") is followed directly by a present-tense verb: لازم أروح البيت (laazim aruu7 el-bayt, "I must go home"). Unlike English "must," لازم itself never changes form — only the verb after it conjugates for the person.
b1plus-lazim.fact: لازم can also stand alone as a short, urgent reply — "لازم!" by itself means something like "You have to!" or "It's necessary!", used the way English might say "You must!" as a complete sentence.

dialogue.native: لازم أروح البيت الحين، تعبان كثير
dialogue.en: I have to go home now, very tired
Good, you should drink water first
